compiler.version:
pandargs: Invalid option "version"

Usage: es2panda [OPTIONS] [input file] -- [arguments]

optional arguments:
--abc-class-threads: Number of worker threads to compile classes of abc file
--base64Input: base64 input of js content
--base64Output: output panda file content as base64 to std out
--bc-min-version: Print ark bytecode minimum supported version
--bc-version: Print ark bytecode version. If both bc-version andbc-min-version are enabled, only bc-version will take effects
--branch-elimination: Enable branch elimination optimization
--cache-file: cache file for incremental compile
--check-transformed-ast-structure: Check the AST structure after transform
--cold-fix: generate patch abc as cold-fix mode
--cold-reload: compile as cold-reload mode
--commonjs: Parse the input as commonjs
--compile-context-info: The path to compile contextinfo file
--debug-info: Compile with debug info
--debugger-evaluate-expression: evaluate expression in debugger mode
--dst-package-name: This is for modify pacakge name in input abc file, and should always be used with srcPkgName. dstPkgName what targeting package name will be modified to.
--dump-asm-program: Dump program
--dump-assembly: Dump pandasm
--dump-ast: Dump the parsed AST
--dump-debug-info: Dump debug info
--dump-deps-info: Dump all dependency files and records including source files and bytecode files
--dump-file-item-size: Dump the size of each kind of file item of the abc file
--dump-literal-buffer: Dump literal buffer
--dump-normalized-asm-program: Dump program in normalized form to ensure the output of source code compilation is consistent with that of abc file compilation.
  The normalized form differs mainly as follows:
  1. all instructions will be labled consecutively and all the labels will be dumped
  2. the content of a literal array, rather than its id, will be dumped when the literal array appears in an opcode or is nested in another literal array
  3. labels stored in catch blocks will be unified
  4. strings won't be dumped
  5. invalid opcodes won't be dumped, local variables' start and end offset will skip invalid opcodes
--dump-perf-metrics: Dump performance metrics
--dump-size-stat: Dump size statistics
--dump-string: Dump program strings
--dump-symbol-table: dump symbol table to file
--dump-transformed-ast: Dump the parsed AST after transform
--enable-abc-input: Allow abc file as input
--enable-annotations: Permits es2abc to compile annotations
--enable-callable-name: Whether to include the function name in call instructions, only available for API24 and above
--enable-ets-implements: Allow es2abc to pass static ETS implementation information from source files to bytecode
--enable-release-column: Enable column number information for bytecode instructions in non-debug mode.
Debug mode: Column numbers are emitted for all instructions.
Non-debug mode:
1. Enabled: Column numbers generated for call instructions only.
2. Disabled: No column number information included.
--extension: Parse the input as the given extension (options: js | ts | as | abc)
--file-threads: Number of worker threads to compile file
--function-threads: Number of worker threads to compile function
--generate-patch: generate patch abc, default as hotfix mode unless the cold-fix argument is set
--help: Print this message and exit
--hot-reload: compile as hot-reload mode
--input-symbol-table: input symbol table file
--merge-abc: Compile as merge abc
--module: Parse the input as module
--module-record-field-name: Specify the field name of module record in unmerged abc
--npm-module-entry-list: entry list file for module compile
--ohmurl-version-config: The path to a JSON file describing rules for adjusting OHMURL version information. This is an [Experimental Feature]. The JSON file must contain the following fields: 
  packageName (string) – the HAR package name to be modified; 
  originVersion (string) – the original version; 
  targetVersion (string) – the new version; 
  updateVersionInfo (object) – a mapping of package names to their updated versions.
--opt-level: Compiler optimization level (options: 0 | 1 | 2). In debug and base64Input mode, optimizer is disabled
--opt-try-catch-func: Enable optimizations for functions with try-catch blocks
--output: Compiler binary output (.abc)
--outputProto: specify the output name for serializd protobuf file (.protoBin)
--parse-only: Parse the input only
--perf-file: Specify the file path to dump time consuming data during compilation process, default to 'perf.txt' in the current directory
--perf-level: Specify the performance data output level:  0: Output compilation time data(default)
--record-debug-source: Record source code to support multi-platform debugger & detailed backtrace in debug mode
--record-name: Specify the record name
--remove-redundant-file: Remove redundant info from abc file and remove redundant source file, which is effective when the compile-context-info switch  is turned on and there is abc input
--source-file: specify the file path info recorded in generated abc
--src-package-name: This is for modify pacakge name in input abc file and should aways be used with dstPkgName. srcPkgName is for finding the targeting package name to be modified.
--target-api-sub-version: Specify the targeting api sub version for es2abc to generated the corresponding version of bytecode
--target-api-version: Specify the targeting api version for es2abc to generated the corresponding version of bytecode
--target-bc-version: Print the corresponding ark bytecode versionfor target api version. If both target-bc-version and bc-version are enabled, only target-bc-versionwill take effects
--transform-lib: aop transform lib file path
--use-define-semantic: Compile ts class fields in accordance with ECMAScript2022
Tail arguments:
input: input file
